part.label: L-Shaped Bracket With Custom Profile
part.description: An L-shaped mounting bracket with a mounting hole in each arm -- a cross-section none of the other 9 component kinds can approximate, built as an extruded_profile instead. Demonstrates that relations, features, and the bounding-box connectivity check all work against extruded_profile the same as any box-like kind, since its footprint's bounding box is well-defined.

components.description: L-shaped footprint: a 40x15 horizontal arm and a 15x40 vertical arm sharing a 15x15 corner, extruded 5mm thick. Points are listed in the profile's own natural coordinate space; the generator centers the bounding box automatically.

features.description: Mounting hole in the horizontal arm, safely inside that arm's material (away from the shared corner).
Mounting hole in the vertical arm, safely inside that arm's material (away from the shared corner).
